summary: Implemented court/judge.py as the thin orchestrator: Application/Judgment NamedTuples and judge(ledger, scope, config) applying fdr_by/fdr_bh, dsr, pbo_cscv, and noise_control under each trial's declared protocol, appending one VerdictRecord per application with engine_version from court.__version__. Decision polarity follows the §5.8 table (FDR rejection-set membership, DSR≥confidence, φ≤threshold, p̂≤alpha each map to court "pass"). Finalized court/__init__.py with __version__="0.1.0.dev0" and public re-exports of ledger records, pure statistics, Application, Judgment, and judge. tests/test_judge.py covers FDR E2E, noise individual/pool_max, DSR and PBO both polarities, status→judged, fail-closed guards, and the public API surface (13 tests).

notes_for_referee: TDD: tests/test_judge.py written first; red phase confirmed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'court.judge' before court/judge.py existed. Judged status derives only from decisions keys (ledger contract), so DSR/PBO leave non-selected scope members at evaluated. noise_control provenance keys are copied into verdict params only when present on the application; null_stats are recorded in both params and computed per §5.8.
